manifest.name: @etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard
manifest.description: Token-usage profile for DeepSeek Harness — a Codex-style usage panel inside Settings: lifetime tokens, a year of activity, cache hit rate and top models. · DSH 用量统计面板：在设置里查看累计 token、一年活动热力图、缓存命中率与最常用模型。
manifest.comment:peerDependencies: These are provided by the DSH host process / browser module table at runtime. They are marked optional so npm never tries to fetch them, and the package itself has no runtime dependencies of its own.

scripts.test: node tests/readme.test.mjs && node tests/fold.test.mjs && node tests/render.test.mjs && node tests/client-bundle.test.mjs && node tests/host-route.test.mjs

bundle.text:
# ============================================================================
# dsh-token-dashboard 的 bundle patch —— 把用量面板挂进 DSH 配置树
# ============================================================================
#
# 【这是什么】
#   这是本插件的"挂载声明"。DSH 启动时按 bundle 层栈把各插件的 patch 叠起来
#   组成配置树，本文件就是 dsh-token-dashboard 这一层的内容。
#
# 【工作原理】
#   - insert：往配置树里添加新的插件行（entry）
#   - 每个 entry 有 id（行标识，patch 覆盖时按它定位）和 name（插件模块）
#   - name 是**包名**（npm 模块名），解析到包入口 lib/index.js（宿主半侧）。
#     本包发布在 @etheslay scope 下，所以 name 必须带 scope，否则解析不到。
#   - package.json 声明了 dsh.client，DSH 的模块系统因此同时把这个包扫描为
#     "浏览器插件"，向页面提供它的 client.js 入口
#
# 【两处硬性约束，改动前请先读】
#   1. id 必须全局唯一。商城上架预检按 id 比对 entryIds，裸名太泛（如
#      token-dashboard）会与其它插件的行标识冲突，整份提交会被判为缺少 entry ID。
#      id **不等于**包名：DSH 自带的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat 用的是
#      `ui-chat`，@michengai/dsh-codex-ui 用的是 `codex-ui`，@michengai/dsh-automation
#      用的是 `dsh-automation`。这里沿用本插件一直以来的 `dsh-token-dashboard`：
#      它已足够独特（npm 上同名的那个包用的是 `token-dashboard`，不冲突），
#      并且宿主半侧导出的 `name` 本来就取这个短名。
#   2. "id: 值" 这一行绝不能写行尾注释。预检用正则抓该行的值并要求其后直接
#      换行，行尾注释会让它抓不到 entry ID。
#
# ============================================================================

- insert:
    - id: dsh-token-dashboard
      name: '@etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard'

readme.text: [English](README.en.md) · [更新日志](https://github.com/Etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · [MIT](https://github.com/Etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard/blob/main/LICENSE)

> [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 设置里的 **Codex 风格用量档案**：累计 token、一整年活动热力图、缓存命中率与最常用模型 —— 数据全部来自本地会话日志，只读、不联网。

---

**桌面应用（Electron 版）** —— profile 填 `desktop`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

**`dsh web`** —— profile 填 `web`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

装完**重开 DSH**，打开 **设置 → 用量**。要求 DSH 0.2.x、Node ≥ 22.18。

> 💡 想更新？把上面那条命令再跑一次，`@latest` 会取到新版本。

> 💡 懒得自己敲？把这句发给能执行终端命令的 agent：**「把 DSH 插件 @etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard 装进我的 desktop profile，装完用 `dsh --profile desktop --dump-config` 确认一下」**（`dsh web` 用户把 `desktop` 换成 `web`）。

> 💡 `--registry` 建议保留：国内默认走 npmmirror，新发布的 scoped 包在镜像上有同步延迟，省掉它可能报 404。

- **五个累计数字** —— `累计 Token 数` · `Token 使用峰值` · `最长任务用时` · `最长连续天数` · `当前连续天数`。都是累计值，所以没有区间选择器
- **一年活动热力图** —— 上下两块各六个月，`每天` / `每周` / `累计总量` 三种模式，`少 ▢▢▢▢▢ 多` 色阶，悬停读出当天用量
- **洞察** —— 最常用的推理强度 · 最常用的模型（按 token 排名，不按回复条数）· 已探索技能数 · 使用的技能总数 · 总会话数 · 总轮次 · 缓存命中率
- **最常使用** —— 调用最多的技能与次数
- **中英双语** —— 跟随 DSH 界面语言；数字与时长也跟着变，显示 `3.7亿`、`46分59秒`，不是 `370M`、`46m 59s`
- **只读、零成本** —— 只读 `$DSH_HOME/sessions` 下的会话日志：不写盘、不调用模型、不发送提示词或消息内容
- **无运行时依赖** —— 宿主侧只用 `node:*`，浏览器侧从 DSH shell 的模块表取 React 与 UI 基础组件
- **版式像 Codex，数据是 DSH 的** —— 复刻 Codex analytics Overview 的版式与格式化规则，但**不编造** DSH 量不出来的东西：额度、套餐、速率窗口一个都没有
> 取自真实运行中的 DSH：本机 18 个会话、10.5 亿 token 的读数，深色主题。数字与时长跟随界面语言。

- **npm 页面** —— [`@etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard)：版本、发布时间、文件清单都在那里
- **插件市场** —— 设置 → 插件市场 → 搜索安装；市场会替你维护 `dsh.profile.bundles`
- **手动** —— `npm install @etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard`，再把包名登记进该 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。**两件事都要做**：只在 bundles 里声明而实际没装，会让 DSH 下次启动失败
- **从源码** —— 克隆仓库后 `npm install && npm run build`，再 `npm run refresh:profile`（见「开发」）

**桌面应用（Electron 版）**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard
```

**`dsh web`**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard
```

记得同时把这个包名从该 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里删掉。插件不留用户数据 —— 它只读会话日志，从不写盘。

- **装好了但设置里没有** —— 先确认 profile 填对了（桌面应用是 `desktop`），再 `dsh --profile desktop --dump-config` 看配置树里有没有 `dsh-token-dashboard`
- **宿主半侧是否挂上** —— 浏览器打开 `http://127.0.0.1:<你的 DSH 端口>/dsh-token-dashboard/api/health`，返回 `{"ok":true,…}` 就是正常
- **提示「插件已更新，需要重启 DSH」** —— 正常现象。浏览器半侧会热替换，宿主半侧是 Node 进程里缓存的 ES 模块，必须重启 DSH 才会换

```sh
npm install
npm run build            # lib/index.js + lib/client.js + lib/types
npm run typecheck
npm test                 # 折叠、格式化与渲染、双语 README、浏览器包、真实日志交叉验证

**改 `src/` 不等于改了 app 跑的东西。** app 加载的是 profile 里那份打好包的副本，`npm run refresh:profile` 才会覆盖它；改动宿主半侧还要重启 DSH。开发工具见 [`tools/README.md`](tools/README.md)。

设计细节、折叠规则、色阶推导与测试策略见[设计说明](https://github.com/Etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard/blob/main/docs/design.md)。
MIT —— 全文见 [LICENSE](https://github.com/Etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard/blob/main/LICENSE)。这里复刻了 Codex 的哪些格式化规则、来自哪里，见 [NOTICE](https://github.com/Etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard/blob/main/NOTICE)。
[中文](README.md) · [Changelog](https://github.com/Etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · [MIT](https://github.com/Etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard/blob/main/LICENSE)

> A **Codex-style usage profile** inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Settings: lifetime tokens, a year of activity, cache hit rate and top models — all of it read from local session logs, read-only and offline.

---

**Desktop app (Electron)** — the profile is `desktop`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

**`dsh web`** — the profile is `web`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

Restart DSH, then open **Settings → Usage**. Requires DSH 0.2.x and Node ≥ 22.18.

> 💡 To update, run the same command again — `@latest` picks up the new version.

> 💡 Rather not type it? Send this to any agent that can run terminal commands: **"Install the DSH plugin @etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard into my desktop profile, then confirm it with `dsh --profile desktop --dump-config`."** (`dsh web` users: swap `desktop` for `web`.)

> 💡 Keep `--registry`: the default registry in mainland China is npmmirror, which syncs newly published scoped packages with a delay — leaving it out can 404.

- **Five all-time figures** — lifetime tokens, peak tokens, longest chat, longest streak, current streak. All cumulative, so there is no date-range picker
- **A year of activity** — two stacked six-month blocks, in Daily / Weekly / Cumulative modes, with a `less ▢▢▢▢▢ more` ramp and a hover readout per day
- **Insights** — most used reasoning · most used model (ranked by tokens, not by reply count) · skills explored · total skills used · total chats · total turns · cache hit rate
- **Most used** — the skills invoked most often, with counts
- **Bilingual** — follows the DSH UI language, and so do the numbers and durations: `3.7亿`, `46分59秒` rather than `370M`, `46m 59s`
- **Read-only, zero cost** — reads the session logs under `$DSH_HOME/sessions` and nothing else: no writes, no model calls, no prompt or message content sent anywhere
- **No runtime dependencies** — the Host half imports only `node:*`; the browser half resolves React and the UI primitives from the DSH shell's module table
- **Codex layout, DSH data** — reproduces the Codex analytics Overview layout and its formatting rules, and **invents nothing** DSH cannot measure: no quota, no plan name, no rate windows
> Taken from a real DSH session on this machine: 18 chats, 1.05 billion tokens, dark theme. Numbers and durations follow the UI language.

- **npm page** — [`@etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard): version, publish date and file list live there
- **Plugin Market** — Settings → Plugin Market → search and install; the market maintains `dsh.profile.bundles` for you
- **By hand** — `npm install @etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard`, then list the package under `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`. **Both steps are needed**: a name declared in `bundles` but not installed makes DSH fail to start next time
- **From source** — clone the repo, then `npm install && npm run build && npm run refresh:profile` (see Development)

**Desktop app (Electron)**:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard
```

**`dsh web`**:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard
```

Remove the package name from `dsh.profile.bundles` in that profile's `package.json` as well. The plugin leaves no user data behind — it only ever reads session logs.

- **Installed, but Settings shows nothing** — check the profile first (the desktop app uses `desktop`), then run `dsh --profile desktop --dump-config` and look for `dsh-token-dashboard` in the config tree
- **Is the Host half mounted?** — open `http://127.0.0.1:<your DSH port>/dsh-token-dashboard/api/health`; `{"ok":true,…}` means it is
- **"Plugin updated, restart DSH"** — expected. The browser half hot-reloads, but the Host half is an ES module cached in the Node process and needs a DSH restart

```sh
npm install
npm run build            # lib/index.js + lib/client.js + lib/types
npm run typecheck
npm test                 # fold, formatting and render, bilingual README, browser bundle, real-log cross-check

**Editing `src/` does not change what the app runs.** The app loads the packed copy inside the profile; `npm run refresh:profile` is what replaces it, and Host-half changes additionally need a DSH restart. Tools are documented in [`tools/README.md`](tools/README.md).

Design notes — panel geometry, the fold rules, how the colour ramp was derived, and the test strategy — live in [docs/design.md](https://github.com/Etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard/blob/main/docs/design.md).

MIT — see [LICENSE](https://github.com/Etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard/blob/main/LICENSE) for the full text, and [NOTICE](https://github.com/Etheslay/dsh-token-dashboard/blob/main/NOTICE) for which Codex formatting rules were reproduced and from where.
